description.7.0: The command only applies to regular (3- or 4-sided) blocks with structured mesh. Multiplier for irregular blocks is always 1. Set the zone multiplier. This setting applies to all regular blocks if < range > is not supplied. The zone multiplier is used to multiply by i the number of zones in the area(s) of interest.
description.9.0: The command only applies to regular (3- or 4-sided) blocks with structured mesh. The multiplier for irregular blocks is always 1.
